description: The broadcasters (platform, region, link) of a bout or of a whole card, with the card start time in UTC; or, with platform (e.g. "DAZN", "ProBox TV"), what is on that platform: its upcoming cards and those of the last 12 months. Give bout_id, event_id or platform. An empty list means none is on record yet. hub_url is the site's «Where to watch boxing this week» page. Pass lang matching the user's language (en, es, ru or ja) so the page links match it.

lang.description: the user's language: en (default), es, ru or ja; the boxerbook.com page links of the answer follow it (a page without a translation keeps its English link)

platform.description: instead of an id: a broadcast or streaming platform by name, e.g. DAZN, ESPN+, ProBox TV, BXNG TV
